title: Generate video with Sora · Level 3
slo: Explain how to create, check, and download a Sora video job.

exercises.question_text: Which statements correctly describe an SDK and curl? Select all that apply.

options.text: An SDK is a developer-friendly toolkit
options.rationale: Correct. An SDK is a developer-friendly toolkit. It helps work with an underlying interface.

options.text: An SDK can sit on an underlying REST API
options.rationale: Correct. An SDK can be built on a REST API. The underlying API remains available.

options.text: curl sends and receives internet data
options.rationale: Correct. Curl sends and receives data over the internet. It can send HTTP requests.
Curl is a command-line tool. A Sora model performs video generation.
options.better_fit: Use this description for a Sora video model.

exercises.explanation: Correct. SDKs are toolkits and curl can make HTTP requests.

options.text: Controls that limit harmful or prohibited use
options.rationale: Correct. Safeguards are restrictions and controls for safer use. They limit harmful, prohibited, or inappropriate use.
Video size controls output format. It does not limit harmful use.
options.better_fit: Use this when choosing dimensions for a request.

options.rationale: Audio generation is a model capability. It is not a safety control.
options.better_fit: Use this when describing Sora 2 audio generation.

options.rationale: Polling monitors an asynchronous job. It does not restrict inappropriate use.
options.better_fit: Use this when checking a video job's status.

exercises.explanation: Correct. Safeguards limit harmful, prohibited, or inappropriate use.

exercises.question_text: Sora 1 makes targeted edits to an existing video instead of regenerating the whole result.

feedback_for_incorrect.intrinsic: An editor could choose the wrong model for a revision.
feedback_for_incorrect.instructional: Sora 2, not Sora 1, supports video-to-video remixing.

exercises.question_text: After creating a video job, download the MP4 before checking whether the job is completed.

feedback_for_incorrect.intrinsic: An app could try to retrieve an unfinished video.
feedback_for_incorrect.instructional: Create the job, poll status, then download only after completion.

exercises.question_text: Put the pieces in the correct order.

feedback_for_incorrect.instructional: State the input capability first, then the missing video-output capability.

exercises.correct_answer: Other multimodal models may process visual input but do not generate video output
exercises.explanation: The sentence contrasts processing visual input with generating video output.

feedback_for_incorrect.intrinsic: The meaning of remix becomes unclear.
feedback_for_incorrect.instructional: Start with the capability, then its action and existing-video target.

exercises.correct_answer: Video remix makes targeted edits to an existing video without full regeneration
exercises.explanation: The ordered sentence distinguishes targeted editing from regenerating a video.

exercises.question_text: A product designer needs short prompt-based clips, optional reference-image guidance, and flexible resolutions for a prototype. Which Sora 1 capabilities support that decision? Select all that apply.

options.text: Creates short clips from text prompts
options.rationale: Correct. This directly meets the need for prompt-based clips. It is a Sora 1 capability.
Correct. This supports the optional reference image. It is available in Sora 1.
Correct. This supports flexible prototype settings. It is a Sora 1 capability.
Video remixing belongs to Sora 2. It is unnecessary for a new prompt-based prototype.
options.better_fit: Use it when making targeted changes to an existing video.

feedback.intrinsic: The designer could choose an irrelevant feature from another model.
feedback.instructional: The stated needs align with Sora 1, while remix belongs to Sora 2.

exercises.explanation: Correct. The stated prototype requirements align with Sora 1.

exercises.question_text: An education producer needs a realistic learning video with generated audio, created from a prompt rather than an existing clip. Which choice best fits?

options.rationale: Correct. Sora 2 supports text-to-video, improved realism, and audio generation. The task starts with a prompt.
Sora 1 can create text-based clips. The need for generated audio and improved realism points to Sora 2.
options.better_fit: Use it for concept videos, storyboards, or visual prototypes.

feedback.intrinsic: The video may not meet the audio requirement.
feedback.instructional: Sora 2 adds audio generation and improved realism.

options.rationale: Remix starts with an existing video. This producer is creating a new video from text.
options.better_fit: Use it for a targeted change to an existing learning video.

feedback.intrinsic: The workflow would expect source video that does not exist.
feedback.instructional: Use Sora 2 text-to-video for a new prompt-based result.

options.rationale: Vision-enabled GPT models analyze visual inputs. They do not create a video with generated audio.
options.better_fit: Use one to explain a diagram or image.

feedback.intrinsic: The producer would get analysis instead of a video.
feedback.instructional: Sora 2 provides the required video-generation capability.

exercises.explanation: Correct. Sora 2 text-to-video fits the stated production requirements.

exercises.question_text: A model that creates original video from prompts is a ___.

parts.text: A model that creates original video from prompts is a

feedback_for_incorrect.intrinsic: The model category would be mislabeled.
feedback_for_incorrect.instructional: Use video generation model for a model whose output is original video.

exercises.explanation: A video-generation model produces video; image-generation and multimodal models are different categories.

exercises.question_text: The command-line tool that can send HTTP requests is ___.

parts.text: The command-line tool that can send HTTP requests is

feedback_for_incorrect.intrinsic: The interface could be confused with its command-line client.
feedback_for_incorrect.instructional: Use curl for the command-line HTTP tool.

exercises.explanation: Curl is a command-line tool for sending and receiving internet data, including HTTP requests.

exercises.question_text: Arrange the following steps in order.

feedback_for_incorrect.intrinsic: The app could try to download an unfinished asset.
feedback_for_incorrect.instructional: Create first, retain the ID, poll status, then download.

exercises.correct_answer: Create video job Receive video ID Poll job status Download completed MP4
exercises.explanation: Creation returns the ID needed for polling, and downloading is last.

exercises.question_text: Which areas are covered by Sora Responsible AI safeguards? Select all that apply.

options.rationale: Correct. Restrictions can involve real people. This is a safeguard area.
Correct. Restrictions can involve copyrighted characters. This is a safeguard area.
Correct. Certain content types can be restricted. Safeguards limit inappropriate use.
Dimensions are generation settings. They are not a Responsible AI restriction.
options.better_fit: Use this when selecting a video's output format.

exercises.explanation: Correct. Safeguards include restrictions involving these areas.
